text-to-image-converter.formula:
canvas width = widest line width + 2 × padding
canvas height = lines × font size × line height + 2 × padding

Example: 64 px font, line height 1.4, padding 24, one line ≈ 154 px wide
width ≈ 154 + 48 = 202 px; height ≈ 64 × 1.4 + 48 ≈ 138 px

text-to-image-converter.quickAnswer: This tool renders typed text into a downloadable image using the canvas API. Type your text, choose a font, size, colors and padding, and the image is sized exactly to fit. Download it as PNG (with optional transparency) or JPEG.
text-to-image-converter.workedExample:
You type "Sale" on one line with 64 px bold Arial, line height 1.4 and padding 24.

The canvas measures the line at about 154 px wide.
Canvas width = 154 + 2 × 24 = 202 px.
Canvas height = 1 × 64 × 1.4 + 2 × 24 = 89.6 + 48 = 137.6 → 138 px.

The result is a crisp 202 × 138 PNG with the word centered — ready to use as a banner label. (Exact pixel widths vary slightly by device font.)
